# GitHub Copilot Instructions for AI Agent Context Trial

## Repository Overview

This repository serves as a trial and demonstration project for GitHub Copilot's AI agent context features. It showcases how to properly configure and utilize AI agent context to enhance code generation, suggestions, and collaboration.

## Project Purpose

- Demonstrate best practices for AI agent context configuration
- Provide examples of effective GitHub Copilot integration
- Serve as a reference implementation for context-aware AI assistance

## Code Style and Conventions

### General Guidelines
- Use clear, descriptive variable and function names
- Follow language-specific best practices and conventions
- Write self-documenting code with minimal but meaningful comments
- Maintain consistency with existing code patterns

### Documentation
- Document all public APIs and exported functions
- Include usage examples in documentation
- Keep README.md up to date with project changes

## Development Workflow

### When Writing Code
- Prioritize code readability and maintainability
- Write modular, reusable components
- Consider edge cases and error handling
- Test code thoroughly before committing

### When Making Changes
- Keep changes focused and minimal
- Update documentation alongside code changes
- Ensure all tests pass before pushing
- Follow the existing project structure

## AI Agent Context Usage

This repository demonstrates:
- Proper configuration of GitHub Copilot workspace context
- Effective use of context files to guide AI assistance
- Best practices for AI-assisted development workflows

## Important Notes

- All AI-generated code should be reviewed and tested
- Context files should be kept up to date with project evolution
- Follow security best practices, especially with sensitive data
- Never commit secrets, API keys, or credentials

## Collaboration Guidelines

- Respond to PR feedback constructively
- Keep commit messages clear and descriptive
- Use issue templates when available
- Tag relevant team members for reviews
